notes: Pepper's guide, the BEGINNERS CLUB (original scene 19: create 0x298a4, controls 0x29587, draw 0x292da). It keeps the music playing (the radio runs on, data/audio/radio.json) and fades in and out over 0.5 s.

The picture (0x292da): the background (layer 1), the question window (layer 2; the original draws it 1.1 times as wide about its centre, so 352 wide from x 38), the arrows while a list has more than five questions (layer 3), the cursor's bar pulsing (layer 7), the questions (layer 8, white, the font's 18-unit cell, 30 apart), Pepper (layer 10), the CURRENT MUSIC strip (257) and the top band (262). Inside a topic the back button's hint shows below the window.
guide: Pepper is shown as a talk scene shows her (the character command 0x40e778, run by 0xc57e0): cast 12, pose 2, fading in, blinking.

The list scrolls round: the cursor moves down the rows shown, then the questions scroll under it, wrapping from the last to the first (0xdf6d0); a list of five or fewer wraps the cursor. Each level's row and scroll are kept between visits, so an answer comes back to the question asked.

confirm plays sys 5. A topic opens its questions; an answer fades out to its talk scene (events 105-127, which return to the guide); End fades out to Club Wired, or to the town map when the guide opened from event 49 (the first visit, after NAME ENTRY). cancel inside a topic plays 8 and closes it; at the top it moves the cursor to End with the cursor sound, unless it is there.

The lessons (FreePlay, basic controls, attack methods, Optic Camouflage) lead to the tutorial battle, scene 42, on the training ground (data/world/training.json names the four screens). The original picks the lesson in the save (0x2928c).

cleared_next: once the game has been cleared (the staff roll, scene 37, sets the flag 0x6dfc1 reads; the quest save's "cleared"), "What is a Ranker?" and "Who is Mona Lisa?" are answered by events 157 and 128 instead.

riding_plate: the RIDING SV plate with the ridden Scoobee's name slides in once the screen has faded in (0x6dd74, see data/ui/frame.json); a new game rides none, so it shows only once a Scoobee is ridden.
